about: The example of levels 6 and 7 (docs/level-6.md, docs/level-7.md): an echo on everything the unit plays, a sound stage after the master effect in a megabyte of working memory, its three values kept with each tape as the member dub_echo. Shift and the metronome key open and close its page in any mode; the blue knob sets the time, the second how much comes back, the third how loud; it starts at level 0, dry. With no tape told of yet, its values are in dub.bin, in a folder the computer does not see. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base. tools/build_all.py builds it into out/examples/.
name: dub
